D/ [--]VALENTINI ANVS PF [AVG] ; R/ SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Valentinian I (364-375) Victory left issue of 364-367, Arles mint, RIC volume 9 no. 9(a), Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust diademed and cuirassed right; large eye. Obverse inscription: [--]VALENTINI ANVS PF [AVG]. Reverse description: Victory advancing left with wreath and palm. OF II in field. Reverse inscription: SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE. In exergue: CON.…
